name: Hunza Valley
tags: mountains valley scenic apricot blossom karakoram forts hiking views peaceful
info: Hunza has Karimabad, Baltit Fort, Attabad Lake and Passu Cones. Autumn colours and spring blossom are the highlights.

name: Skardu
tags: lakes desert mountains adventure trekking k2 deosai shangrila camping
info: Skardu is the gateway to K2 treks. Visit Shangrila Lake, Sarfaranga Cold Desert and the Deosai Plains.

name: Swat Valley
tags: green river valley family hotels meadows waterfalls kalam malam jabba budget
info: Swat is called the Switzerland of Pakistan. Try Malam Jabba, Kalam and Mahodand Lake.

name: Murree
best_time: year round, snow in December to February
tags: hill station snow weekend family close islamabad lahore pindi point mall road cool
info: A quick hill-station escape from Lahore and Islamabad. Mall Road and Patriata chairlift are popular.

name: Naran and Kaghan
tags: lake saiful malook mountains jeep honeymoon meadows lalazar babusar river
info: Visit Lake Saiful Muluk and Lalazar, and take the jeep ride to the lake.

name: Lahore
tags: city food history culture mughal fort mosque shopping walled old heritage street badshahi
info: See Badshahi Mosque, Lahore Fort, Shalimar Gardens and eat on Food Street in the Walled City.

name: Islamabad
tags: city modern margalla hills faisal mosque monal viewpoint hiking capital clean
info: Faisal Mosque, Margalla Hills trails and Daman-e-Koh are the highlights.

name: Mohenjo-daro
tags: history ancient archaeology indus civilization ruins unesco heritage
info: A UNESCO World Heritage site and one of the largest ancient cities of the Indus Valley Civilization.

name: Fairy Meadows
tags: nanga parbat trek camping meadow adventure hiking stars views jeep
info: A trek or jeep ride from Raikot Bridge leads to this meadow with a direct view of Nanga Parbat.

name: Gwadar
tags: beach sea coast sunset port hammerhead fishing ocean
info: Visit Gwadar Beach, Hammerhead Rock and Padi Zirr for coastal sunsets.
